name: MALACHII Sovereign OS
truthBoundary: RC1.6 adds authenticated local multi-process worker daemons, live nonce-challenge A3 observation, signed receipts, durable worker leases, per-round routing refresh, capability-revocation propagation and worker-loss failover above the RC1.5 Live Control Fabric. This proves loopback multi-process distribution semantics, not multi-host HA, distributed consensus, SPIFFE/SPIRE attestation, external provider/A2A/MCP certification, production browser execution or Agent Foundry.
superUserWorkRequired: none for normal boot/verification; external high-impact actions still require policy authorization
